_comment: REUSABLE TEMPLATE for per-load characterization. Copy this file, rename to <load>.json, fill values. Every measured value carries value + confidence + source/basis. null = not yet measured. Derived from dorm_fridge.json; validated against chest_freezer.json.

identity.notes: REMINDER: nameplate_current_a is a locked-rotor MAX, NOT run current. Run current is compressor-class (~0.7A for these). Scale control_constants off MEASURED running current.

factory_spec._comment: Optional. Add if the unit has a performance sticker / EnerGuide. See chest_freezer.json for the pattern: performance_sticker table + energuide + measured_vs_spec deltas.

channel_binding.comment: Where this load was measured. Deployment binding lives in controller config, not here.

inrush_peak_a.notes: WARNING: 10Hz/100ms-RMS sampling cannot resolve true inrush; any value is method-limited, not a surge peak.

plateau_a.notes: PTC shelf vs capacitor/relay-start identifies compressor_type.

control_constants.comment: Scale off MEASURED running_current_a, never nameplate. RESCALE overcurrent per load.

start_confirm_a.basis: ~half of running current, above noise floor (~0.10A).

stop_a.basis: below run, above noise, below start_confirm for hysteresis.

start_debounce_ms.basis: sustained above start_confirm confirms real run vs stall.

max_offer_ms.basis: policy: satisfied box shows only noise -> release slot.

min_off_ms.basis: anti-short-cycle, survives resets. >=180s PTC cooldown floor; confirm under hot-restart stress.

overcurrent_trip_a.basis: above steady run, below stall. RESCALE per load.

overcurrent_trip_ms.basis: must exceed a healthy start's inrush excursion.

thermal.comment: From RTD(s). SINGLE compartment: one block. DUAL (fridge): duplicate 'compartments' into fresh_food + freezer, each with its own rtd_channel, band, warmup/pulldown.

duty_cycle.notes: MAKE-OR-BREAK PARAMETER. Note ambient with every observation. Rotation budget: 3 loads share one inverter one-at-a-time; sum of duties must stay well under 100%.
